preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 500.
The number of edges m must be between 1 and the minimum of n(n-1) and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any(graph.is_acyclic_after_removal(edge) for edge in edges) else stdout == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output must be 'YES' if the graph can be made acyclic by removing at most one edge, otherwise 'NO'.
